# Introduction
Project Goal: 
    The project goal is to identify distinct team archetypes 
    for college basketball by using clustering based on offensive and defensive 
    metrics. We will then aim to analyze how archetype combinations perform 
    against each other in different matchups.

## Data Collection

head(data)

# PCA
```{r pca}
# 1. Select only numeric columns for PCA
numeric_features <- data %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%

# Select only complete numeric columns suitable for PCA
# Focus on key basketball metrics and avoid identifiers or categorical variables

# First, identify numeric columns
numeric_cols <- sapply(data, is.numeric)
numeric_data <- data[, numeric_cols]

# Remove columns with too many missing values (optional threshold)
missing_pct <- colMeans(is.na(numeric_data))
good_cols <- names(missing_pct[missing_pct < 0.1])  # Keep columns with <10% missing values
numeric_data <- numeric_data[, good_cols]

# Now handle remaining NAs with imputation
# For simplicity, use median imputation, but consider more sophisticated methods if needed
numeric_data <- apply(numeric_data, 2, function(x) {
  x[is.na(x)] <- median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  return(x)
})

# Convert back to data frame
numeric_data <- as.data.frame(numeric_data)

# Check for and remove any constant columns
var_cols <- sapply(numeric_data, var, na.rm = TRUE)
numeric_data <- numeric_data[, var_cols > 0]

# Now perform PCA on the cleaned data
pca_res <- prcomp(numeric_data, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

# Summary of PCA
summary(pca_res)

# Scree plot to examine variance explained
screeplot(pca_res, type = "lines")

# Plot the first two principal components
biplot(pca_res, scale = 0)

# Alternatively, create a nicer visualization with ggplot2
pc_data <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x)
ggplot(pc_data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "PCA of College Basketball Teams",
       x = paste0("PC1 (", round(summary(pca_res)$importance[2,1]*100, 1), "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", round(summary(pca_res)$importance[2,2]*100, 1), "%)"))
```

# Clustering Analysis

## Determine Optimal Number of Clusters
```{r optimal-clusters}
# Select PCs explaining ~85% of variance (looks like around PC23)
pc_features <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x[, 1:23])

# Add team names for reference
pc_features$TeamName <- data$TeamName

# Determine optimal number of clusters
set.seed(123)  # For reproducibility

# Calculate WSS (Within-cluster Sum of Squares) for different k values
wss <- function(k) {
  kmeans(pc_features[, 1:23], k, nstart = 25)$tot.withinss
}

# Try 1-15 clusters
k_values <- 1:15
wss_values <- sapply(k_values, wss)

# Plot WSS vs number of clusters (Elbow method)
plot(k_values, wss_values, type = "b", 
     xlab = "Number of Clusters (k)", ylab = "Total Within-cluster Sum of Squares")

# Alternative using factoextra
# fviz_nbclust(pc_features[, 1:23], kmeans, method = "wss")

# Silhouette method (alternative)
# fviz_nbclust(pc_features[, 1:23], kmeans, method = "silhouette")
```

## Perform Clustering
```{r clustering}
# Perform k-means clustering
set.seed(123)
k_optimal <- 3 
kmeans_result <- kmeans(pc_features[, 1:23], centers = k_optimal, nstart = 25)

# Add cluster assignments to your data
pc_features$cluster <- kmeans_result$cluster
data$cluster <- kmeans_result$cluster
```

## Visualize Clusters
```{r cluster-visualization}
# Visualize clusters in PCA space
fviz_cluster(kmeans_result, data = pc_features[, 1:23],
             palette = "jco", # Color palette
             ellipse.type = "convex", # Concentration ellipse
             ggtheme = theme_minimal(),
             main = "Cluster Plot")

# Look at characteristics of each cluster
cluster_summary <- data %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarize(across(c(eFGPct.x, TOPct.x, ORPct.x, FTRate.x), mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            count = n(),
            avg_offensive_rating = mean(AdjOE, na.rm = TRUE),
            avg_defensive_rating = mean(AdjDE, na.rm = TRUE),
            avg_tempo = mean(AdjTempo, na.rm = TRUE))

print(cluster_summary)
```

## Analyze Team Archetypes
```{r archetype-analysis}
# Identify distinct team styles within each cluster
cluster_archetypes <- data %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarize(
    # Offensive archetypes
    tempo = mean(AdjTempo, na.rm = TRUE),
    shooting_pct = mean(eFGPct.x, na.rm = TRUE),
    turnover_rate = mean(TOPct.x, na.rm = TRUE),
    offensive_rebounding = mean(ORPct.x, na.rm = TRUE),
    free_throw_rate = mean(FTRate.x, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Defensive archetypes
    defensive_efficiency = mean(AdjDE, na.rm = TRUE),
    opp_shooting = mean(OppFG2Pct.x, na.rm = TRUE),
    forced_turnover_rate = mean(StlRate.x, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print(cluster_archetypes)

# Name the clusters based on their characteristics
# For example: "Fast-paced shooters", "Defensive grinders", etc.
```
